def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    sofr_changes = [0.014, 0.016, 0.018, 0.020, 0.022]
    notional_principal = 1_000_000
    fixed_rate = 0.025
    basis_points = 0.0035
    years = 5

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_gain_or_loss = 0

    for year in range(years):
        variable_rate = sofr_changes[year] + basis_points
        annual_gain_or_loss = notional_principal * (variable_rate - fixed_rate)
        total_gain_or_loss += annual_gain_or_loss

    # return answer
    return round(total_gain_or_loss)
